terra.problem: The text says the cloth was clean, but does not say whether it was a scrap or where it came from.
“No rushing, no shortcuts” adds details about how Joseph handled the body that the text does not give.
“Himself” asserts that Joseph personally cut the tomb, and “gives up” suggests he relinquished it. The text does not establish either detail.
Saying a cart would have been funny substitutes a claim of humor for a joke and feels flat.
The comparison with the memory of Jesus’ friends is unsupported by this passage and has no reference for the outside claim.
“Jesus never says that” makes an unsupported claim beyond the passage. The cited verse establishes what others said, not everything Jesus never said.
Identifying Elijah as a prophet of Israel is a fact from outside this passage and needs its own reference.
